{{Top|leg|title=''Lambda'' group}}
'''''Lambda'' group''' was a group of seven [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] owned by members of the [[Leafar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. While on a business trip, ''Lambda'' group was part of a convoy with ''[[Yavin Express]]'' and ''[[Cargo-Go]]'' that was [[Imperial ambush of the Leafar|ambushed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A number of the shuttles escaped with the aid of forces from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
